entries.3f5591334010cb8f: A sporting goods manufacturer headquartered with its main plant in Chichibu, Saitama Prefecture, whose main business is manufacturing and selling carbon golf shafts. The company does not prepare consolidated financial statements and has no affiliated companies. The number of employees as of February 28, 2026 was 128. The company is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market. The company has a single segment consisting only of sporting goods-related business, and revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥2,711 million. Revenue from external customers by business division was ¥2,455 million for golf shaft manufacturing and sales, ¥172 million for golf club assembly and processing, and ¥83 million for other. In the US market, the main customer is the agent PRO'S CHOICE GOLF SHAFTS, INC.
entries.41e8c12c082048bd: Carbon golf shafts (design-in products for club manufacturers)
entries.4b52d0b13616e1d6: Under its corporate philosophy of 'Monozukuri that brings smiles to people around the world,' it aims to expand its sales base, strengthen cost competitiveness and improve sustained earnings capacity. As priority issues to address, in its core Golf Shaft Manufacturing and Sales Business it will work to raise brand value and create stable profits, and it will pursue a higher share of the iron market by establishing and expanding the 'RAUNE' iron shaft brand, and improve brand exposure by strengthening tour support in coordination with the tour representatives of its U.S. distributor. It also aims to establish a second business base that complements the golf shaft business, and will advance the development and manufacture of CFRP products applying carbon fiber lamination technology.
entries.4de9cf579f440d39: A business started in September 1999 to strengthen relationships with golf club manufacturers, among other purposes, specializing in contract processing of custom-made products within golf club assembly and processing. It is also used to research trends for the company's own-brand golf shafts. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥172 million.

External customer revenue by business division for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥2,455 million for golf shaft manufacturing and sales, ¥172 million for golf club assembly and processing, and ¥83 million for other.

entries.9407c6feb147c89f: This business model involves manufacturing carbon shafts at its in-house factory in Chichibu, Saitama Prefecture, and generating revenue from sales to golf club manufacturers and distributors in Japan and overseas, as well as from contract assembly and processing of golf clubs received from club manufacturers.
entries.98a5df1c2bbec998: In the golf industry, purchases of leisure goods have become dispersed as consumer trends diversify, and sales volumes of golf clubs and related products have remained roughly flat compared with the previous fiscal year. Each club manufacturer is expected to further strengthen inventory management, and the company views that difficult conditions will continue. Within this environment, the company supplies high-priced, high-value-added shafts to club manufacturers in Japan and the United States, and has a business structure with a high proportion of sales to the U.S. market.
entries.a3a489326ca98eeb: Its head office factory is located in Chichibu, Saitama Prefecture. The company was established in 1989, and as of February 28, 2026, it had 128 employees. Its shares are listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market.
entries.a42ec19ffa1ee013: For the fiscal year ended February 2026, revenue was ¥2,711 million and net income was ¥144 million. Custom orders for its own-brand shafts fell short of expectations, and revenue was below the previous fiscal year's level. In the current fiscal year, it has been making capital investments centered on the construction of a new factory, and is reviewing and streamlining its production structure.

entries.cc752bdb6bda5be5: Its features are its specialization in manufacturing and selling carbon shafts and its design-in development structure, in which it proposes and advises on club manufacturers' new product development from the planning stage. Because its products are difficult to automate with machinery, skilled personnel produce them by hand one at a time, and the quality and technology built up over many years have led to adoption in relatively high-priced, high-value-added golf clubs. It also works to apply test-hit evaluations by PGA TOUR players and shaft data to product development.
entries.d03760b3fc5c2625: It develops and manufactures CFRP products that apply carbon fiber lamination technology. In addition to applied research and development of its patented 'Plastic Working Pipe', including joint industry-academia research, it has co-developed with automotive parts manufacturers and commercialized optional parts for sport-type production cars. In sports fields other than golf, it has also entered the markets for supporting and selling handles for curling brooms, sports blowguns, and billiard cues. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥83 million.

entries.fa51494b8dfc35d1: It specializes in manufacturing and selling carbon shafts, with golf club manufacturers and agents in Japan and the United States as its main customers. Its feature is “design-in”, providing proposals and advice from the planning stage for new club maker products, and developing and supplying, for each club, the shaft best suited to the performance of the club head adopted. Its products are mainly adopted in relatively high-priced, high value-added golf clubs. In Japan and the United States, it also sells replacement shafts through retail stores (golf shops). Some products for the US market are manufactured by a contract manufacturer in China. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥2,455 million.
